name: Rockdene Beach House
accommodation: Whole house with five bedrooms, sleeps 8+
parking: On-site parking for two cars plus free on-street parking nearby
dogs: Guide dogs permitted; check with owner for other pets
beachAccess: About 0.2 miles to East Strand and 0.4 miles to West Strand; Whiterocks about 1.5 miles
confirmedFeatures: Beach changing room, hot tub, games room, sea-view terrace, private garden, log/coal fire, washing machine and tumble dryer, WiFi
overview: A five-bedroom 1919 house on Bath Terrace in Portrush, renovated with modern interiors and period features. It sleeps eight or more, with a games room, hot tub, sea-view terrace and a dedicated beach changing room. East Strand is roughly a quarter of a mile away and West Strand under half a mile, with Whiterocks a short drive east.
surfTripFit: A beach changing room, laundry and parking make it a practical group base within walking distance of both Portrush strands.
